data.name: Ibrat
data.long_meaning: A person who gives a reminder or warning to someone. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'ibrahat', which means 'to warn'. It is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be wise and intelligent, and to serve as a reminder to others of important lessons and values.
data.spiritual_meaning: To inspire and guide others towards the right path. To act as a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom, and to use this knowledge to serve others and make a positive impact on the world.
data.numerology_meaning: Creativity, self-expression, and communication are the key themes for this name. People with the name Ibrat are often very expressive and have a deep appreciation for art and beauty. They are also natural communicators, and may be drawn to careers in the media or the arts.

The root أ-ب-ر is mentioned in the Quran, which gives the name Ibrat religious and spiritual significance. It symbolizes the importance of reflection and guidance in one's life.
